note: Set A is preferred because it correctly extracts essential document metadata such as the revision table and project information, which Set B omits entirely. Both sets exhibit a similar number of binding errors, such as attributing roof detail members to the floor cantilever detail, and both misinterpret the slope symbol as a weld in at least one claim. Although Set B correctly identifies the drawing scale while Set A mislabels it as spacing, Set A's comprehensive extraction of the title block and revision history provides greater overall value and fewer vague claims.
